page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The processor includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX, AVX-512, and cryptographic instructions like AES and SHA_NI. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.g7nex.2xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory metrics. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1525.0 and a multi-core score of 5771.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 11362.25. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 427.91 GB/sec, which drops to 57.95 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 41.38 GB/sec. While static web serving throughput is stable at 11.47 GB/sec, Redis SET operations are a relative bottleneck, registering in the bottom 25% at 7.8 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer predictable performance for standard enterprise workloads without the premium of specialized memory or compute-heavy instances. Given the lack of local storage, it relies on network-attached storage options. The instance is well-suited for general-purpose applications, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
